clean_room_boundary.final_verdict_basis: The exact current oracle and provenance bytes, their bound accepted public authority and current schemas, and a fresh full adversarial sweep. Earlier mutable-v12 findings were used only as regression attacks, not as expected truth.

checks.detail: Oracle and provenance byte lengths and SHA-256 values recomputed exactly; every declared authority and schema binding matched.
All nine source cases preserved proposal or extraction state, support, applicability, host decision, conditions, passage identity, response identity, and lifecycle meaning.
All six candidate cases preserved supported, unsupported, contradicted, unavailable, abstained, and protected-effect-rejected distinctions without self-admission.

The pre-deletion source-body passage is absent from source_execution_input.passages, the retained passage contains only the deletion marker, and the distinct extracted claim legitimately survives in the retained transcript with its transport condition, fingerprint, unavailable support, audit-only decision, and no consumer application link.

Silver-latch version and use-state qualifiers, unavailable blue-valve version and startup qualifiers, and the deleted claim transport qualifier close through five condition facts and recomputed substring hashes.
Contradiction requires visible direct opposing evidence; unsupported is not false; the blue-valve meta-statement remains distinct from the attempted proposition and explicit abstention.
Deleted-material and protected-effect mutations begin from generically schema-valid admitted triples and isolate their respective lifecycle and policy rejections.
Source correlation and candidate link zero/two probes are individually schema-valid and expected to fail only the exact-one host-decision invariant.
All 25 support/applicability pairs are unique and only supported plus applicable is admitted.

Passage, local-fact, opposing-evidence, preimage, attempted-proposition, citation, condition, proposal, response, operation, owner, root-subject, application, and evidence bindings closed without mismatch.

No product output, comparison result, implementation, tests, prior package, prior gate review, private fixture, live material, archive, credential, manifest, registry, or Git history supplied expected truth.

closed_correction_findings.final_check: Protected-effect proposals remain proposed or extracted; rejection exists only on the host-decision axis.
Revision-seven and service-hatch-use conditions are retained by closed condition identifiers and local facts.
The cited meta-statement and attempted proposition are separate; provider and host abstention remain explicit.
The marker, retained source-body fingerprint, review-only preimage binding, surviving extracted claim, and audit-only lifecycle are explicitly separated.
The deleted-admission mutation is generically schema-valid before the deletion-specific policy rejects it.
Source and candidate result families each contain isolated zero and two host-decision probes.
The deletion marker remains a passage-lifecycle marker while the original extracted proposition and its condition survive separately.
Revision-seven and during-startup qualifiers are retained without asserting local applicability.
Absence is scoped only to the pre-deletion source-body payload in source_execution_input.passages; the retained transcript claim is explicitly allowed to survive.

review_boundary: This record reports only the Gate 3 adversarial review of the exact unaccepted, un-compared v12 candidate. It does not accept or seal the package, compare product output, establish a private result, or make a reliability or readiness claim.
